mapper.select: SELECT tdm41_company_id FROM tdm41_manl_duty WHERE tdm41_manl_duty_id = #{manlDutyId}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS manl_duty_id , '['||tdm20_role_nm||'] '||tdm10_task_nm||' : '|| CONCAT(tdm12_seq||'. ', tdm12_content) AS title , CONCAT(tdm13_seq||'. ', tdm13_content) AS task_relate_duty_name , org_nm AS org_name2 , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm41_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , CASE WHEN COALESCE(tdm10_common_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '공통' ELSE '개별' END AS task_gubun , tdm10_task_nm AS task_name , tdm41_manl_duty_id AS real_manl_duty_id , CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm42_manl_org WHERE tdm42_manl_job_id = tdm41_manl_job_id AND tdm42_role_id = tdm41_role_id ) = 0 THEN false ELSE true END AS use_yn
ORDER BY tdm41_role_id, tdm41_task_id, tdm12_seq, tdm13_seq LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY task_name COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8") AS manl_duty_id , t.* FROM ( SELECT tdm41_company_id AS company_id , tdm41_manl_job_id AS manl_job_id , tdm41_role_id AS role_id , tdm42_exct_id AS exct_id , tdm41_task_id AS task_id , tdm10_task_nm AS task_name , tdm44_org_id AS org_id , org00_kor_nm AS org_name , COUNT(*) AS task_relate_duty_cnt FROM tdm40_manl_job INNER JOIN tdm41_manl_duty ON tdm41_manl_job_id = tdm40_manl_job_id INNER JOIN tdm44_manl_duty_org ON tdm44_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id INNER JOIN tdm42_manl_org ON ( tdm42_manl_job_id = tdm41_manl_job_id AND tdm42_role_id = tdm41_role_id AND tdm42_org_id = tdm44_org_id ) INNER JOIN tdm10_task ON tdm10_task_id = tdm41_task_id INNER JOIN LATERAL getOrg(tdm40_company_id, tdm40_manl_apply_start_date) ON org00_org_id = tdm44_org_id WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} AND tdm41_role_id = #{roleId} GROUP BY tdm41_company_id , tdm41_manl_job_id , tdm41_role_id , tdm42_exct_id , tdm41_task_id , tdm10_task_nm , tdm44_org_id , org00_kor_nm ) t
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tdm42_manl_org WHERE tdm42_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} AND tdm42_role_id = #{roleId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm42_manl_org WHERE tdm42_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm42_manl_org WHERE tdm42_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} AND COALESCE(tdm42_lock_yn,'false') = 'true'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm41_manl_duty WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm44_manl_duty_org WHERE tdm44_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm42_manl_org SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , tdm44_org_id , tdm30_person_id , tdm41_role_id , 'false' , null , null , null , #{manlJobId} , #{updName} , f_sysdate() FROM tdm41_manl_duty INNER JOIN tdm44_manl_duty_org ON tdm44_manl_duty_id = tdm41_manl_duty_id INNER JOIN tdm40_manl_job ON tdm40_manl_job_id = tdm41_manl_job_id INNER JOIN LATERAL getTdm30RoleAllc(tdm40_company_id, tdm40_manl_apply_start_date, true) ON tdm30_role_id = tdm41_role_id WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} GROUP BY tdm44_org_id, tdm30_person_id, tdm41_role_id, tdm40_reg_date
mapper.update: UPDATE tdm44_manl_duty_org SET tdm44_end_yn = 'false' , tdm44_end_date = null , tdm44_end_emp_id = null , tdm44_upd_nm = #{updName} , tdm44_upd_date = f_sysdate() WHERE tdm44_manl_duty_id IN ( SELECT tdm41_manl_duty_id FROM tdm41_manl_duty WHERE tdm41_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId} )
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(tdm40_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM tdm40_manl_job WHERE tdm40_manl_job_id = #{manlJobId}
